The '''Barcaria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sombure sector/Legends|Sombure sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

The system was known for its [[Barcarian claw salt|claw salt]].
